question_group: Questions 5 to 7 are based on the news report you have just heard.

options.A: Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.
options.B: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
options.C: A villager was searching for his lost cash.
options.D: A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.

options.A: They return it to the finder.
options.C: They place a notice in The Northern Echo.
options.D: They hand it over to the local government.
